name: Emerald Dawn
source:
As the sun sets for the bloody war, a new dawn shines on the land beloved by the Goddess. Blue skies and gentle breezes finally return, ushering in the era of peace to Fodlan.

With the fate of Rhea unknown after the final battle, Byleth occupied himself with his mission to eliminate the remaining threats to Fodlan. After an unsuccessful hunt, he returns to Garreg Mach, the place where it all began.

What awaits Byleth in his return? Will his prayers finally be answered?

[From [url=https://sendo.itch.io/emerald-dawn]Itch.io[/url]]

A fangame of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fire_Emblem:_Three_Houses]Fire Emblem: Three Houses[/url].
translation:
随着血腥战争的落日西沉，崭新的黎明照耀在受女神眷顾的大地上。湛蓝的天空与和煦的微风终于归来，为芙朵拉迎来了和平的时代。

决战之后蕾雅生死未卜，贝雷特便全身心投入到清除芙朵拉残余威胁的使命之中。在一次无果的搜寻过后，他回到了加尔古·玛库——一切开始的地方。

归来的贝雷特将会遇到什么？他的祈祷最终能否得到回应？

[引自[url=https://sendo.itch.io/emerald-dawn]Itch.io[/url]]
